summary: PollerBehaviorAutoscaling uses ForkJoinPool.commonPool() which doesn't inherit the context class loader from Spring Boot, causing Kotlin method references to fail despite the required library being on the classpath.
userImpact: Users running Spring Boot applications with Kotlin and PollerBehaviorAutoscaling enabled encounter runtime failures when using Kotlin method references with Async, despite the required temporal-kotlin library being on the classpath.
rootCause: PollerBehaviorAutoscaling uses ForkJoinPool.commonPool() which doesn't inherit the context class loader from the WorkerFactory's initiating thread, causing Spring Boot's LaunchedClassLoader to be replaced with the default AppClassLoader.
proposedFix: Modify PollerBehaviorAutoscaling to properly inherit or propagate the context class loader from the initiating thread when submitting tasks to ForkJoinPool.commonPool().
resolutionDetails: PollerBehaviorAutoscaling was modified to properly handle context class loader inheritance when using ForkJoinPool with Spring Boot environments.
keyQuote: When PollerBehaviorAutoscaling is enabled, worker threads are assigned jdk.internal.loader.ClassLoaders$AppClassLoader instead of Spring Boot's LaunchedClassLoader
